_about: Save flags the songs/trade/cows plugin (tools/rando/parity/songs_trade.py) uses for 'given once' at locations whose vanilla reward repeats (cows, Hyrule Loach). The save-data list (GameData/GameDataList) can't take new flags (growth untested), so these are existing permanent flags (ResetType 8, saved) that nothing in the game sets: IsGet.<actor> for abstract base actors that can never enter the pouch, then HavePlayedEvent.<scene ID> for template scene IDs no file references (data/eventsetting_unreferenced.json). Read from the files; that the game never sets them is inferred (no file names them), not seen in-game. Other plugins needing flags: take from 'free' and move them to 'assigned' here (or a shared registry), so two plugins never share one. GF Cow (the remake-only Gerudo Fortress cow) takes a flag of the shared borrowed pool (tools/rando/free_flags.py: an unrequested Navi balloon's saved bool, type327, after the windows the claim build scripts take theirs from, so rebuilding them takes the same flags), listed in 'flags_claimed' so free_flags.CLAIM_FILES ('songs_trade_cows') keeps it out of the drops and fairies plugins' picks while a seed holds it (shuffle_cows on). HavePlayedEvent.Npc_Talk_Base (another NPC template row, like the Npc_*_Base ones above) added to 'free'; the BancChange*_Base and PlayOcarina_Base template rows were left out: code may start those templates itself.
